name: Shrieker
disable: DC 18 Survival check to carefully approach and cut the mushroom's air sac without triggering the shrieker

items.name: Shriek
items.text:
Trigger A creature or light source approaches within 10 feet of the shrieker or the shrieker takes damage.

---

Effect The shrieker emits a deafening screech that deals 1d6 sonic damage to creatures within 30 feet (DC 16 basic Fortitude save save; creatures that critically fail this saving throw are Deafened for 1 minute).

text: This human-sized purple mushroom emits a piercing shriek when disturbed.
